content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I recently received a [product_name] and I'm struggling to upload my web server to it. I uploaded the file to the SD card using the 'Deploy to SD card' function and activated web server access through the [product_name]'s settings. After reinserting the SD card into the device, when I attempt to upload the project using the 'Upload' button, I get the error: 'Download Failed! There is no file system in SD Card.' Any help would be appreciated!

The SD card needs to be formatted with FAT32 and must be no larger than 32 GB. If you use a card larger than 32 GB, create a FAT32 partition that remains within those limits. Use full (slow) formatting, not quick formatting. What does the diagnostics in the [product_name] indicate? Check: Main menu > Diagnostic > Hardware > SD card.
I've formatted the SD card with FAT32, but I still encounter the error: 'Download Failed! There is no file system in SD Card.'
The [product_name] is unable to read the SD card. Potential reasons include: incorrect formatting or using a card of the wrong size, SD card not properly inserted, or bent pins in the card slot.
Attached is a photo showing a card slot with bent pins.

analysis.insight_summary: A user consistently faces a file system error when attempting to upload a web server project to a [product_name] using an SD card, despite properly formatting the card. Responses highlight hardware compatibility requirements, error messages, and potential hardware faults. The user finds the troubleshooting steps confusing, especially in distinguishing between file system problems, SD card formatting issues, and physical device faults, complicating the resolution process.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects an uncomplicated upload process given the correct steps, including proper SD card formatting and project deployment. They also anticipate clear and informative diagnostic feedback from the device when an error occurs.
